text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'u is the output of a generic solar fleet per MW of AC capacity; the anomaly is u minus its month-by-half- hour mean. Five Primary substations, daylight half-hours of April to September, forecast runs every 5 days from July to September 2025 and March to June 2026.'
